clue.text: Looked mischievous, being found in pit

indicators.note: being found in a word means sitting inside it, so the impish word goes into the stone word

parts.note: a pit is the stone of a fruit, a seed
arch means playfully mischievous, as in an arch look

explanation.surface: Someone peered impishly while discovered down a mine shaft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Looked' is the definition in the sense of hunted, not glanced; 'pit' is a fruit stone, not a hole in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to have looked for something is to have hunted or combed for it.

clue.text: Appropriate set of furniture for duke to sit on? On the contrary

indicators.text: to sit on? On the contrary
indicators.note: the surface puts the duke on the furniture, but on the contrary in a down entry puts the furniture above the duke

parts.note: a suite is a matching set of furniture, as in three-piece suite

explanation.surface: A sofa set fit for a duke to sit on.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective synonym: something suited to a purpose is appropriate or fitting.

clue.text: Welcome performance around church piano

indicators.note: around means the performance word goes about the church and piano letters

parts.note: an act is a performance on stage
CE is the Church of England
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A recital in a church with piano gets a warm reception.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer needs two Cs inside ACT; the blog reads 'church' as abbreviations, so it supplies both C and CE.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to welcome an offer or person is to receive them gladly.

clue.text: Hit in the face by a mate

parts.note: to chin someone is to punch them on the jaw

explanation.surface: Struck in the face by a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: China plate is cockney rhyming slang for mate, a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang: china, short for china plate, means a friend or pal.

clue.text: Foes? See mine fighting

indicators.note: fighting means thrashing about, so the letters of see and mine are mixed up

explanation.surface: Look at those adversaries battling it out over a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: foes are opponents or adversaries.

clue.text: Small fireplace sufficient for one

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
an ingle is a fireplace or hearth, as in inglenook

explanation.surface: A tiny hearth that only warms one person.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed or room meant for just one person is called this, as opposed to a double.

clue.text: Before demonstrating, this person is advancing

indicators.note: before places the contraction ahead of the showing word

parts.note: this person is the speaker, so I'm, short for I am
proving means demonstrating or showing to be true

explanation.surface: Someone says they are getting better before giving a demonstration.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: getting better or making progress is advancing.

clue.text: Under obligation, dropping rate fully? Only partially

indicators.note: Only partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Owing a debt, someone only half reduces the charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling obliged or beholden to someone for a favour means being thankful to them.

clue.text: Plot in Greene novel

indicators.note: novel means new or fresh, so the letters of in Greene are made into a new order

explanation.surface: A storyline in a Graham Greene book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' pretends to be a book by Greene but is the anagram signal; 'Plot' is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to engineer something is to contrive or scheme to bring it about.

clue.text: Willing in recording to embrace policy

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold around, so the recording wraps the policy word

parts.note: a CD is a compact disc, a recording
a line is a policy, as in the party line

explanation.surface: Keen, on tape, to back a political platform.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being disposed or minded to do something means being prepared to do it.

clue.text: Leapt sideways at first before car crash

indicators.note: before places the opening letter ahead of the crash word
at first asks for the opening letter of the word sideways

parts.note: prang is British slang for a minor car crash

explanation.surface: Someone jumped sideways just ahead of a motor accident.
explanation.walkthrough: PRANG is informal British English for a minor collision.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense synonym: to have leapt is to have jumped or bounded up suddenly.

clue.text: Complaint as British price rises

indicators.note: rises in a down entry means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a fee is a price or charge

explanation.surface: Grumbling as UK costs go up.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: a beef is a grievance or grumble.

clue.text: Worried MP? Ease his stress

indicators.note: worried means agitated or disturbed, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: An anxious politician is told to relieve his tension.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' reads as a noun for worry but is the verb: to lay emphasis on.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to stress a point is to give it particular weight or prominence.

clue.text: Canoe at sea in vast expanse

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters of canoe are jumbled

explanation.surface: A small boat afloat on a huge body of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge body of salt water is the classic example of a vast expanse.

clue.text: Views in both directions

indicators.note: in both directions says the word reads the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone takes in the scenery looking both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: someone who views something looks at it or observes it.

clue.text: Passing me her pale shifts

indicators.note: shifts means moves around, so the letters of me her pale are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone goes by as a pale woman changes position.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something fleeting or short-lived is passing, lasting only a moment.

clue.text: One left consumed by composer's lack of success

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside, so the composer's name surrounds the other letters

parts.note: Gabriel Fauré was a French composer
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A single leftover piece eaten by a musician who has flopped.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a flop or fiasco is a lack of success.

clue.text: I go without new trumpet? That's stupid

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so I go goes around the new letter

parts.note: taken from the clue as written
to rant is to trumpet or declaim loudly

explanation.surface: A musician says going without a new trumpet would be foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking knowledge or sense; in informal use it means foolish or dense.

clue.text: Most of story is prior to fellow's charm

indicators.note: prior to places the earlier pieces ahead of the fellow word
most of means the story word loses its final letter

parts.note: a tale is a story
taken as written
a man is a fellow; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: A tale about a man's personal appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: An object thought to bring luck or ward off harm is a charm or amulet.

clue.text: Picturesquely described exotic cigar must be taken outside public house initially

indicators.note: taken outside means wrapped around, so the jumbled cigar goes around the initials
exotic means strange or foreign, so the letters of cigar are rearranged
initially asks for the first letter of each of the words public and house

explanation.surface: Smokers must step out of the pub to light their foreign cigars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' turns CIGAR into GRAIC, which goes around PH, the usual abbreviation for a public house.
explanation.definitionFit: A vivid, detailed account is called graphic, painting a clear picture in words.

clue.text: Green remains behind Conservative

indicators.note: behind means the remains word follows the Conservative letter

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Environmentalists' leftovers tail behind a Tory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' is not the party but slang for money (greenbacks).
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: green, from the colour of US banknotes, means money.

clue.text: Son has time to be a scholar

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A boy has a period of time to become learned.
explanation.definitionFit: A wise and learned person, especially a revered thinker, is a sage.

clue.text: American turns up very loudly with diamonds — that's cut the mustard

indicators.note: turns up in a down entry means the American abbreviation reads from bottom to top

parts.note: FF is fortissimo, the musical marking for very loudly
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: A loud American flashing jewels claims to measure up.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to cut the mustard is to be good enough, to be adequate.

clue.text: Notice sign of approval from teacher before test's oddly removed

indicators.note: before places the approval mark ahead of the remaining letters

parts.note: a tick is the mark a teacher puts by a right answer

indicators.note: oddly removed drops the first, third and fifth letters, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A teacher's mark of approval appears before half the exam is cancelled.
explanation.definitionFit: A label or tag giving information, as on a price notice, can be called a ticket.

clue.text: Means business

definitions.meaning: the means or instrument by which something is done
a firm providing a service, such as a travel firm

explanation.surface: Someone declares they are serious about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the medium by which something acts, and a company that acts for clients.

clue.text: I am touring university after work, getting narcotic

indicators.note: after means the touring part comes behind the work word

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

indicators.note: touring means going around, so I am wraps the university letter

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am

explanation.surface: Someone tours a campus after a job and comes back with drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug made from poppy sap is a classic example of a narcotic.

clue.text: Prosecute about two females encountering phone call ordeal

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the legal word goes around the two letters

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action against someone
F is the abbreviation for female; two of them give FF
a ring is a phone call, as in give me a ring

explanation.surface: Taking two women to court after a phone call is a trial in itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an ordeal is a painful, distressing experience to endure.

clue.text: Get admission to hospital department supported by the Queen

indicators.note: supported by in a down entry means the queen letters sit underneath

parts.note: ENT is ear, nose and throat, a hospital department
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen

explanation.surface: Being admitted to a hospital ward with royal backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to go into a place or gain entry to it.

clue.text: Carry a torch for daughter getting stuck in a bog

indicators.note: getting stuck in places the daughter letter inside the following words

parts.note: a mire is a bog or swamp

explanation.surface: Someone loves a girl who has got trapped in a swamp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carry a torch for' is an idiom for secretly loving someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: carrying a torch for someone means loving or looking up to them.

clue.text: Wrong lass almost clutched

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the girl word loses its last letter

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
taken means grabbed or seized

explanation.surface: A girl was very nearly grabbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone in error or wrong about something is mistaken.

clue.text: Suggestion by the French creates quarrel

parts.note: a tang is a hint or trace of flavour
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French remark sparks a row.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tangle is an argument or fight, as in tangle with someone.

clue.text: Second time in bank, behind closed doors

parts.note: sec is short for second, as in wait a sec

indicators.note: in places the time letter inside the trusting word

parts.note: to bank on is to rely on

explanation.surface: A second spell at the bank, done in private.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' is the verb, as in bank on, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: things done behind closed doors happen privately, out of public view.
